# Miqui Cussó — Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Miqui Cussó, film editor and postproducer. Showcases editing, post-production and finishing work on audiovisual projects. Site: miquelcusso-rgb.github.io.

## Pages

- [Editing](https://miquelcusso-rgb.github.io/): selected film editing work (commercials, brand films).
- [Post](https://miquelcusso-rgb.github.io/post/): post-production and finishing work, as Furiosa Studio.
- [Contact](https://miquelcusso-rgb.github.io/contact/): contact form and LinkedIn.

## About

- Miqui Cussó is a film editor and postproducer.
- Specialties: film editing, post-production, color grading, video editing.
